title: Even partite matching code condition
statement: For $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$ and a matching code of size parameter $rk$, decode the code on the list $0,1,\ldots,2rk-1$. The code is even partite precisely when every decoded pair $(a,b)$ satisfies $\lfloor a/k\rfloor\ne\lfloor b/k\rfloor$.
hypotheses_covered: A matching code with size parameter $rk$
